question: Do the three deposits behind Wang 2025 establish exact sample identity, matrix joins, measurement scales and the biological design that each later PGAM reproduction stage would require?
decision: Decide which of Wp-R1 to Wp-R5 may open, and at which evidential level, before any expression value of this paper is analysed.
strongest_rival: Matching totals conceal a different population: an aggregated matrix whose library order is assumed rather than declared, TPM columns joined by name alone, or library and division labels mistaken for independent animals.
discriminator: Recorded-hash verification of every input, one-to-one matrix-column-to-GSM joins, per-suffix barcode counts against declared library count, explicit absence markers for undeclared animal fields, and donor codes recovered from titles rather than assumed.
exposure_record: Every figure, conclusion and STAR Methods section of the source was read before this contract was written, and the deposited record fields, matrix headers, barcode suffix counts and TPM column names were inspected in a dry run of this entrypoint outside the governed runner on 4 October 2026. No expression value was read in that dry run, and this contract adds no new outcome; the freeze does not undo the exposure.
biological_unit: Animal for the mouse deposits and donor for the human deposit; the single-cell deposit declares two animal labels and the bulk deposit declares none.
nesting_and_overlap: Single cells are nested in 8 libraries from 2 animals, one animal per condition cell. Bulk libraries carry no animal or culture field, and Div.1 and Total are different gated populations of the same culture rather than replicates. Human samples nest two tissues within donor for 10 of 12 donor codes. The 2021 Wagner package reuses the same method and overlapping authors, so it is one evidence lineage, not independent support.
population_and_selection: All sample records of GSE289733, GSE290297 and GSE138266, all barcodes of the deposited aggregated single-cell matrix, and all columns of the deposited bulk TPM matrix. No selection on any outcome, score or expression value.
contrast: No biological contrast. The comparisons are identity and design concordance: declared library count against aggregation suffixes, sample records against matrix columns, and declared fields against the fields each later stage would need.
endpoint: Verified input hashes, per-series sample inventories, the aggregation-suffix table with an explicit mapping status, the bulk column join, the bulk design counts, the human donor pairing map, and a per-stage eligibility decision with its reason.
methods: Standard-library parsing of GEO SOFT sample blocks and of the gzipped barcode, feature and TPM headers. SHA-256 and byte size of every manifest entry are recomputed and compared to the recorded values, and execution stops on any mismatch. Only headers and record fields are read; no matrix body and no expression value. Unknown fields are left empty rather than inferred, and the assumed cellranger aggr order is recorded as unresolved rather than applied.
missingness_and_exclusions: No sample is excluded. Absent animal, donor and suffix-mapping fields stay empty and are reported as absent. Any hash or size mismatch, duplicate matrix column or unmatched join stops the run rather than being reconciled.
multiplicity: No hypothesis test is performed; every number is a source inventory count, so no multiplicity adjustment applies.
precision_basis: Metadata qualification supplies no effect margin, power statement or biological precision claim, and the counts it reports are not estimates of a population quantity.
interpretation_limit: Source identity and design inventory only. Nothing in this run establishes independent biological replication, metabolic flux, protein-level effects, agreement with the published figures, or that any later stage will reproduce them. An eligible status means a stage may open descriptively, not that its result would support population inference.
stop_rule: Stop on any input hash or size mismatch, any duplicate or unmatched matrix column, or any contradiction between declared library count and aggregation suffixes. After extraction, Wp-R2 stays held pending a solver licence and an imputation decision, Wp-R5 stays held with no deposited values, and no stage is promoted beyond descriptive on the basis of this run.
amendment_reason: Initial prospective execution version for this package. Outcome exposure is full and recorded; no predecessor contract exists.
